description: An object as for_each gives blocks in lexicographic order of its property names, not source order
notes: A JSON object is an object value. The README's example iterates a tuple and its section on unknown values names lists, maps and sets, but it never mentions objects, what the iterator's key is, or in which order blocks are generated. hashicorp/hcl iterates objects with go-cty's ElementIterator, which gives the property names as keys in lexicographic order rather than the order of the JSON text (expandBody.expandBlocks in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go), as the native syntax spec defines for for expressions.
